# Template: isometric_blocks
Named 3D blocks standing on an isometric floor grid, each block's name written on its top face, with optional arrows along the floor between blocks. Blocks are placed by grid cell and can be wider, deeper or taller than one cell. Choose this scene for system-architecture or infrastructure sketches in 3D (servers, services, databases, a data centre, a network), a factory floor or warehouse layout, a small city block or campus plan, or any "isometric diagram of these parts and how they connect". Keep block names short — they are written on the blocks — and leave two empty cells between linked blocks so the arrows have floor to run on. Rows run toward the viewer, so put tall blocks in low rows (the back) where they hide nothing. Not for quantitative data (a 3D bar chart distorts values — use a flat chart).
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "blocks": {
   "type": "array",
   "description": "1–12 blocks. Cells must not overlap.",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Short name written on the block's top face (≤ 10 characters reads best)."
     },
     "at": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
       "type": "number"
      },
      "minItems": 2,
      "maxItems": 2,
      "description": "[column, row] of the block's back-left cell. Columns run back-to-front along the right, rows run back-to-front along the left: [0, 0] is the far corner, and higher numbers come nearer the viewer. Default [0, 0]."
     },
     "size": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
       "type": "number"
      },
      "minItems": 3,
      "maxItems": 3,
      "description": "[columns wide, rows deep, height], default [1, 1, 1]. Height 0.3–4."
     },
     "color": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
       "blue",
       "green",
       "yellow",
       "orange",
       "purple",
       "red",
       "grey"
      ],
      "description": "Default: cycles through the palette."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "name"
    ]
   }
  },
  "links": {
   "type": "array",
   "description": "Arrows from one block to another, by name — following the floor line between them, drawn over the blocks, from one block's outline to the other's.",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "from": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "to": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "both_ways": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Arrowheads at both ends (default false)."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "from",
     "to"
    ]
   }
  },
  "floor": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw the floor slab under the blocks (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- floor: the floor the blocks stand on (present unless floor is false)
- block_<i>: block i (in the order given), a group of its visible faces
- block_<i>_name: block i's name, on its top face — or just above the block when the top face is too small or covered, or placed by the label solver (with a leader) when the block is hidden behind a taller one
- links: SET — every link arrow; naming it stands for all of them, and each keeps its own link_<k> id
- link_<k>: the k-th link arrow that could be drawn (a link between blocks that touch or overlap on screen is skipped)
- title: the title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw an isometric diagram of a web app: load balancer, two app servers, a cache and a database." → params: {"title":"A small web service","blocks":[{"name":"LB","at":[0,2],"size":[1,1,0.6],"color":"purple"},{"name":"App 1","at":[3,0],"size":[1,1,1.1],"color":"blue"},{"name":"App 2","at":[3,4],"size":[1,1,1.1],"color":"blue"},{"name":"Cache","at":[6,0],"size":[1,1,0.7],"color":"orange"},{"name":"DB","at":[6,4],"size":[1,1,1.3],"color":"green"}],"links":[{"from":"LB","to":"App 1"},{"from":"LB","to":"App 2"},{"from":"App 1","to":"Cache"},{"from":"App 2","to":"DB"}]}
Request: "Sketch a warehouse floor in isometric: receiving, storage racks, packing and shipping." → params: {"blocks":[{"name":"Racks","at":[0,0],"size":[2,1,2],"color":"grey"},{"name":"Receiving","at":[0,3],"size":[2,1,0.5],"color":"yellow"},{"name":"Packing","at":[4,0],"size":[2,1,0.5],"color":"orange"},{"name":"Shipping","at":[4,3],"size":[2,1,0.5],"color":"red"}],"links":[{"from":"Receiving","to":"Racks"},{"from":"Racks","to":"Packing"},{"from":"Packing","to":"Shipping"}]}
Request: "Draw a small office network in isometric: internet, firewall, switch, two servers and a NAS." → params: {"title":"Office network","blocks":[{"name":"Internet","at":[0,0],"size":[1,1,0.5],"color":"grey"},{"name":"Firewall","at":[3,0],"size":[1,1,0.8],"color":"red"},{"name":"Switch","at":[3,3],"size":[1,1,0.4],"color":"yellow"},{"name":"Web","at":[6,1],"size":[1,1,1.4],"color":"blue"},{"name":"Mail","at":[6,4],"size":[1,1,1.4],"color":"blue"},{"name":"NAS","at":[1,6],"size":[1,1,0.9],"color":"green"}],"links":[{"from":"Internet","to":"Firewall","both_ways":true},{"from":"Firewall","to":"Switch"},{"from":"Switch","to":"Web"},{"from":"Switch","to":"Mail"},{"from":"Switch","to":"NAS"}]}
Request: "Sketch a small campus plan: library, lecture hall, lab building and cafeteria." → params: {"blocks":[{"name":"Library","at":[0,0],"size":[2,2,1.6],"color":"purple"},{"name":"Lectures","at":[4,0],"size":[2,1,1],"color":"blue"},{"name":"Labs","at":[0,4],"size":[2,1,1.2],"color":"green"},{"name":"Cafe","at":[4,3],"size":[1,1,0.5],"color":"orange"}]}

In YAML: `template: isometric_blocks` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
